║    NAKED_REMOTE                                                      ║

║                                                                      ║
║    REMOTE_VALUE_PAIR                                                 ║
║      Remote and Value with similar names in the same folder          ║
║      CRITICAL - value changed after calling the Remote               ║

║    READABLE_MODULE                                                   ║
